chunks: Do they say: "He has fabricated it?" Tell them: "If I have fabricated it, you have no power to save me from God. He knows what you are busy with concerning this. He is sufficient as witness between you and me; yet He is forgiving, ever-merciful."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'He is sufficient as witness between you and me' in Surah Ad-Dhariyat?
ai.summary: In the Surah of Adh-Dhariyat, this verse responds to the Meccan disbelievers' accusation that Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) fabricated the Quran, asserting that God Himself is the sufficient witness between the Prophet and his detractors. It highlights the divine attribute of 'Alim' (All-Knowing) regarding the subtle claims ('what you pour forth') of the accusers, while concluding with the reassuring attributes of Al-Ghafur and Ar-Rahim to comfort the Prophet amidst their denial.
